built_by: BEST-15 assembly (subagent) — mined scan15_raw/15b (138 unique PubMed hits, 19 threads) + peer_review_scan_v1..v14 + tonight's 4 banked tests
laws: per-item stratification: BANKED = testable now with artifacts on disk / PULL-REQUIRED = needs new data lanes
honest-nulls carried as findings (OH county-grain null, IMD-waiver funding null, SMHA-spend client-outcome null)

items.direction: care leads bookings in the Simes-Jahn frame; lag ordering testable
items.evidence: BANKED TONIGHT (care_bookings_ordering_v1.json, 9-city panel, NYC facility wedge); pattern-lead status

items.association: Within-city component care-per-capita (parks+libraries+health+human_services) vs murder rate, lag-arc strengthening
items.direction: NEGATIVE (spend up -> murders down): pooled r=-0.509 n=28; t-1 r=-0.572, t-2 r=-0.628 (strengthens with lag); libraries Memphis r=-0.90, parks Cincinnati r=-0.80
items.novelty: NOVEL-ANGLE replicated; county-grain null (oh_within_arc_test_v1) = wrong-conductor evidence

items.association: Psychiatric inpatient bed capacity vs suicide mortality, WITHIN-county
items.evidence: MINED scan15 (PMID 42164341, Sweden 20 counties 2015-2024, 2026; between-county RR 0.892); v10 capacity-crime VERIFIED side
items.novelty: VERIFIED (new strongest within-design); US-state/county replication untested
items.testable_with: needs US county bed-supply series + suicide/mortality files

items.association: Local psychiatric bed capacity <-> jail populations (the US Penrose micro-arc)
items.direction: BIDIRECTIONAL: abrupt bed DECREASE -> +256 jail inmates (CI 3.3-509); bed INCREASE -> -199 jail inmates (CI -457 to +59)
items.evidence: MINED scan15 (PMID 33438865, event-study 1988-2015, c=4) + v10 Penrose canon (Mundt, Rajkumar, Wild) + CEECA 33.8% bed decline vs +36% prison (PMID 34557842, c=17) + SSA (36056592) + NZ discharge->prison rise (41778630)
items.novelty: VERIFIED across designs; the jail-swap is the mechanism bridge for care-crime
items.stratification: PULL-REQUIRED (bank a US-county beds x jail panel; Murder/crime side on disk)

items.association: Funding policy (Medicaid SMI/SED 1115 IMD waivers) -> bed capacity: NULL
items.direction: NULL: DiD ~ -24 beds/100k (CI -115,+67); waiver option uncorrelated with capacity, SMI prevalence, or suicide rates
items.evidence: MINED scan15 (PMID 41035307, 50 states DiD 2014-2023) — the honest-null that sharpens the congregation thesis (dollars do not automatically become beds where the service sits)

items.direction: NEGATIVE (coverage up -> crime down), small-but-real across DiD/RCT designs
items.evidence: BANKED v1 (5 expansions studies) + v14 (Oregon-RCT 2024, AEJ 2025, SSRN 2017 DiD, child-maltreatment PMID 35213252)
items.stratification: PULL-REQUIRED (state Medicaid-lane for city panel join)

items.association: MEDICAL DEBT (county debt-in-collections) -> violent crime: NOBODY has tested it
items.direction: Predicted NEGATIVE (more collections -> more stress/predation -> more crime); the single crime-adjacent study runs the arrow in REVERSE (incarceration -> medical debt)
items.evidence: v14 GAP verdict: county ecological designs point at cancer/mortality/housing only (42612687; 35442439; 41525068)

items.association: 13-18 summer youth employment (wage-stipend + structured time) -> violent-crime arrests
items.direction: NEGATIVE, large: -43% violent-crime arrests (Heller 2014 Science RCT n=1,634); READI risk-tail ~1/3 fewer shooting/homicide arrests
items.evidence: v12 age-ladder VERIFIED side (Kessler 2021, Leos-Urbel 2014, Modestino & Paulsen 2019)
items.novelty: VERIFIED effect; age-band split + transport lever NOVEL

items.direction: Behavior VERIFIED (Durlak metas), crime endpoint UNTESTED; the one direct test null-to-small (Gottfredson 2004); deviancy-training backfire risk (Rorie 2011)
items.novelty: GAP (under-13 band never compared to 13-18 in one design)

items.association: Unstructured out-of-home spare time (13-17y) -> adolescent crime prevalence
items.direction: POSITIVE (more unstructured time -> more offending), cross-national 2026; structured-setting caveat (youth clubs not uniformly protective)

items.association: LIBRARY (cultural-institution) spending -> crime: park-within-city negative confirmed, library side near-empty in literature
items.direction: Parks NEGATIVE-within-city (verified-with-nuance); libraries banked locally: Memphis r=-0.90, Detroit r=-0.734, pooled r=-0.527; 80x cross-area composition gradient NOVEL
items.stratification: BANKED (library+park components already in city_component panel)

items.association: Reactive/timing policy: TANF welfare-to-work push -> ADOLESCENT delinquency UP
items.direction: POSITIVE (reform -> adolescent delinquency/risky behavior up) — the reactive-book harm signature; EITC side mixed (maternal work up, child cognition -0.14 SD)
items.evidence: v6 (TANF intergenerational 2020; EITC unintended-consequence 2026) feeding v9 two-book frame (reactive $3.31-$1 MST-CAN ledger)

items.direction: POSITIVE with inverse bed-prison trends in 17/30 CEECA countries; Med-illness jail-share growth canon; one honest counter-anchor (Salisbury & Thornicroft 2016)
items.evidence: v10 (Penrose canon VERIFIED) + mined cross-national confirmations (34557842, 36056592, 41778630)

items.association: Student-loan indenture as NAMED mechanism (person-following obligation + wage capture + no bankruptcy exit) -> civic outcomes
items.direction: Mechanics each VERIFIED (non-dischargeability->SLABS, homeownership delay 60+ cites, family-formation delay 42+ cites, MH century-review); single named-mechanism + civic-outcome test ABSENT
items.evidence: v13 (Dissent 2008 named-frame essays exist; no peer-reviewed operationalization)

items.association: State MH-agency per-capita expenditure + parity -> client-level outcomes
items.direction: MOSTLY NULL: top-10 vs bottom-10 spend states — NO significant difference in treatment receipt, unmet need, suicide or overdose mortality; significant only for cost-related barriers. System-level: parity -> infrastructure allocation (p=0.0002)
items.evidence: MINED scan15 (PMID 42750086 client-level 2026; PMID 40426012 system-level 2025) — spend alone does not reach the point of service: the congregation thesis' sharpest published corroborator
items.novelty: VERIFIED-null supporting the founder's resource-congregation claim
